title: Minimax ATE Estimation with Discrete Covariates and Near-Randomized Propensities
banked_reason: D0.5.G triage: incremental below field floor; headline theorem is unestablished because signed-hybrid covariance/classification and marked-mixture likelihood/conditioning calculations remain incomplete.
gap_reasons: The load-bearing transition from (23)--(27) to the assertion that all ratio-branch and classification contributions have the stated bias and variance is not reproduced: the proof never fixes a pilot threshold that simultaneously controls false-heavy light cells and false-light heavy cells, nor expands the selected estimator's full light/heavy decomposition.  Thus (29) omits unaccounted pilot-selection terms.

The proof requires lower-bound b/alpha to be reduced arbitrarily in (47)--(48), whereas lem:signed-hybrid-risk requires the same globally defined b/alpha to be sufficiently large.  The sentence allowing separately calibrated constants contradicts the single B,M defined in the core; separate lower-bound tuning symbols and a re-derived construction are required.

The proof applies the fuzzy-prior testing reduction (62)--(64) for every d>=2, but lem:marked-mixture's concentration argument only supplies separated target intervals when Delta^2 is at least order 1/n; below that it explicitly relies on the parametric floor.  The theorem must split those cases before asserting (64).

The advertised matched effective-log frontier is not proved because the signed-hybrid argument jumps from a coefficient bound to the central second-moment and covariance estimates (16)–(18), then disposes of all ratio-branch and classification contributions by assertion.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 proposed an all-finite-d minimax frontier using a signed four-block estimator and normalized common-mass four-mark lower prior. D0.5 found central covariance, classification, likelihood, tuning, and small-separation arguments unproved; the headline is unestablished and no Lean formalization began. The bank tier follows the operator's literal below-field stop rule; the raw general-referee response called the proof gaps salvageable despite the persisted unsalvageable halt, so a future retry must first resolve those derivations and rerun review.
tldr: Under the certified restricted-design condition \(\sup_{k:p_k>0}|\pi_k-1/2|\le\delta\le\delta_0<1/2\), binary-treatment, binary-outcome ATE estimation over arbitrary masses on at most \(d\) cells has uniform minimax MSE \(\mathsf R_{n,d,\delta}\asymp n^{-1}+\delta^2\min\{1,[d/\{n\log(e+n\delta^2)\}]^2\}\) for every integer \(n\ge1\), every finite integer \(d\ge1\), and every \(0\le\delta\le\delta_0\). The explicit four-block signed hybrid attains the upper bound, including the falsely-light conditional variance \(O(n^{-1})\) and radius-scaled mean bound at \(L_{\delta}=\log(e+n\delta^2)\); an explicit parametric pair and normalized same-class four-mark prior give the matching converse. For \(S=n\delta^2\ge1\), the parametric and saturation elbows are \(nL_{\delta}/\sqrt S\) and \(nL_{\delta}\). Thus exact randomization gives \(n^{-1}\), fixed positive \(\delta\) recovers the \(\log n\) scale, and the array \(S=\log\log n\) genuinely uses \(L_{\delta}\asymp\log\log\log n\), not \(\log n\).
gap: The direct paper's Theorem 2 is displayed for the treated-arm mean under ordinary fixed positivity on \(d\lesssim n\log n\), with the immediately preceding sentence extending the same rate by analogous arguments to the ATE, while the accepted estimator has tuning and constants calibrated at \(\log n\) on the common fixed-interior range. Neither result characterizes the stricter, certified near-balanced assignment class uniformly as its known tolerance shrinks, and neither supplies a saturated \(d\gg n\log n\) conclusion for this proposal to inherit.
fill: A total signed four-block polynomial estimator, an explicit one-cell parametric two-point experiment, and a nonparametric common-mass marked experiment with a complete Bernoulli potential-outcome coupling are posed on the same arbitrary-mass causal framework. The polynomial degree is \(M=\max\{3,\lfloor\alpha L_{\delta}\rfloor\}\) throughout. On the concrete active range, every factorial order is below the response-block size; elsewhere the estimator is exactly the centered fallback. The active estimator uses one specified polynomial on all real arguments, so falsely-light cells are covered by the stated construction and by an explicit tail obligation. Ordinary positivity is retained as the published baseline implied by the single novel certified near-balance restriction, not as a redundant assumption. Matching the Stage 0 bounds would deliver one constant-factor phase diagram spanning exact randomization, slowly shrinking radii, and fixed overlap; failure at the effective logarithm triggers an honest corrected rate over the unchanged class.
